**Observation Log:**

[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/30 (Tue) 10:59  
[EVENT] User recently got a pair of Dr. Martens.  
[EVENT] User received a shoe cleaning kit today.  
[PREFERENCE] User is looking for tips on how to condition leather boots.  
[CHANGE] User noticed that the leather on their Dr. Martens is starting to crack.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Dr. Martens are typically made from smooth, full-grain leather.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended steps for conditioning leather boots:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Check the type of leather.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Read the care label.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Clean the boots with a soft-bristled brush or cloth.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Apply a leather conditioner to a test patch.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Wait and inspect the test patch.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Apply conditioner to the entire boot in a circular motion.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Let it absorb for at least 30 minutes to an hour.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Buff the boots with a clean, dry cloth.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Additional tips include using a high-quality leather conditioner, conditioning regularly every 2-3 months, avoiding over-conditioning, and storing boots properly.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Stackable shoe cubbies.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Wall-mounted shoe rack.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for choosing the right shoe rack include measuring closet space, considering shoe collection, and reading reviews for durability
